//: This project exists only to serve api/og.mjs; the site itself runs on Cloudflare Workers and proxies /api/og here. Without ignoreCommand, every push to main rebuilt it for nothing. Exit 0 skips the build, exit 1 builds — so `git diff --quiet` skips unless the OG function or this config actually changed.
ignoreCommand: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- api/og.mjs vercel.json og-static
